top_categories.workout_context: 86ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Granfondo Campagnolo Roma, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Campagnolo Roma. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Campagnolo Roma's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
76 miles on paved Italian roads through Rome and the Castelli burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
6,560ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.

Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Campagnolo Roma. Practice on paved Italian roads through Rome and the Castelli: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 76 miles.
6,560ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,560ft of climbing on paved Italian roads through Rome and the Castelli does to your power file on race day.
76–85% FTP for extended efforts. At Granfondo Campagnolo Roma, tempo is the floor you'll live on. Make it feel easy.
Low-cadence force work supports 6,560ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Granfondo Campagnolo Roma's 76 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and G Spot to prepare you for 76 miles of paved italian roads through rome and the castelli romani volcanic hills in Rome, Lazio, Italy.
